result.title: PrimiTok: Learning to Diversify and Allocate Primitives for Visual Tokenization
result.summary: Unifying visual understanding and generation requires representations that preserve both semantic information and fine-grained image details. Continuous tokenizers trained primarily for semantic alignment may omit fine-grained reconstruction details, whereas discrete tokenizers face information loss from codebook quantization. Conventional multi-codebook designs assign every token the same number of codewords regardless of local content. We instead view codewords as reusable visual primitives whose allocation and composition adapt to each token. We introduce PrimiTok, a compositional visual tokenizer that represents each visual token through adaptive allocation and weighted composition of learned codebook primitives. PrimiTok integrates two complementary components: Diverse Quantitative Primitives (DQP), which encourages diversity among sub-codebook centroids to reduce redundancy, and a Dynamic Primitive Allocator (DPA), which selects primitives according to token complexity. Embedding quantization error supervises how many primitives are selected from each sub-codebook, and DPA aggregates them with input-dependent weights. Joint reconstruction and image--text contrastive learning encourage the resulting representations to retain visual fidelity and semantic alignment. Experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction and semantic alignment over SOTA baselines, with further evaluations on multimodal understanding and visual generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PrimiTok 组合式视觉 tokenizer，把码字视为可复用视觉基元：DQP 增强子码本质心多样性以减少冗余，DPA 依 token 复杂度自适应选择并加权组合基元，用量化误差监督选择数量，联合重建与图文对比学习训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 按内容复杂度动态分配离散表示容量的机制，可能与 LVR 中「视觉细节是否保留在内部状态」及按需计算分配的思路有关，可供核查；但工作聚焦 tokenizer 重建与语义对齐，未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成或停止决策。
